purpose: Preserve all 139 V19AN exposure-extension groups while replacing only the 37 stale NSC _d2 descriptors with authoritative NOIRLab Archive primary-plus-HDU retrieval identities determined from frozen sky coordinates.

archive_fallback.authority: NSF NOIRLab Astro Data Archive public REST API
archive_fallback.eligibility_rule: Use archive fallback if and only if the already-frozen NSC exposure identifier ends in _d2; do not test pixel quality or HTTP outcome to choose a route.
archive_fallback.filename_query_rule: Remove only the terminal d2 token from the stale exposure identifier and require exactly one spatially matching current archive image whose basename starts with the remaining prefix.
archive_fallback.representative_coordinate_rule: Use the lexicographically smallest frozen NSC object ID in the exposure-extension group for the metadata-only spatial identity query.
archive_fallback.required_retrieval_shape: public URL containing exactly the primary header and authoritative spatially matched HDU: ?hdus=0,<hdu_idx>

retrieval.resume_rule: Reuse an existing exact output path only after reopening and revalidating its FITS, finite-pixel and WCS containment properties.

claim_boundary: The source route is a transport identity, not an exposure-quality choice: 102 non-d2 groups keep their frozen NSC SIA URLs and all 37 d2 groups use authoritative archive HDU discovery.
A pass establishes complete calibrated-image retrieval and structural/WCS integrity only. It does not establish PSF quality, deblending, galaxy flux, color, stellar mass or mass current.
Archive subset products may contain a larger detector footprint than SIA group cutouts; no pixels outside structural validation may be interpreted in V19AO.
No ambiguous counterpart, lensing/halo payload, gravity result or untouched holdout is accessed.
